description: Defines the TrustStoreWin class, an implementation of TrustStore that interacts with Windows certificate stores for trust management. Includes nested CertStores struct for managing certificate store collections, and methods for initialization, trust retrieval, and issuer lookup.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin
classes.description: An implementation of TrustStore that uses Windows certificate stores to find trust anchors, designed to be thread-safe.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores
classes.description: A struct managing multiple certificate store handles, with factory methods for different testing and initialization scenarios.

methods.name: CreateForTesting
methods.description: Creates a TrustStoreWin instance with specified CertStores for testing.

methods.name: InitializeStores
methods.description: Loads user settings from Windows CertStores.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Determines trust level for a given certificate.

methods.name: MaybeInitializeAndGetImpl
methods.description: Ensures stores are initialized and returns pointer to internal implementation.
